PART I PRELIMINARY PART II ABOLITION OF OFFICE OF HEREDITARY PATEL AND OF WATANS APPERTAINING THERETO PART III ABOLITION OF OFFICE OF STIPENDIARY REVENUE PATEL PART IV CONSEQUENTIAL PROVISIONS Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Abolition of patel watans together with incidents thereof. Section 4. Powers of Collector to decide certain questions and appeals. Section 5. Regrant of watan land to watandar. Section 6. Regrant of watan land to authorised holder. Section 7. Special rule of succession to be void. Section 8. Application of existing tenancy law. Section 9. Eviction of unauthorised holder and regrant of watan land to him in certain circumstances and disposal of land not regranted. Section 10. Method of awarding compensation for abolition, etc., of rights of any other person in property. Section 14. Procedure before Revenue Tribunal. Section 17. Limitation. Section 18. Court-fees. Section 19. Finality of award and decision of Revenue Tribunal. Section 20. Inquiries and proceedings to be judicial proceedings. Section 21. Mode of payment of compensation. Section 22. Amount of arrears of land revenue, etc., to be deducted from the amount of compensation. Section 23. Delegation of powers. Section 24. Rules. Section 25. Savings. Section 26. Abolition of office of stipendiary revenue patel and construction of references. Section 27.
